sentences.text: The genus is known from a partial skull and four teeth found at the Blasi 2 site.
A primitive crocodilian trait is the contact between the frontal bone and the margin of the supratemporal fenestra.
The frontal bone is unusual because its anterior end is extremely long.
Near the frontal bone, the lacrimal bones are unusually wide compared to their length.
Arenysuchus can be distinguished by an infratemporal bar that is tabular, vertically oriented, and has extreme lateromedial compression.
A sharp projection of the frontal bone divides the nasal bones, which make up most of the midline snout length.
The fossil remains were discovered in the Tremp Formation at Arén, Huesca, Spain, by researchers José Manuel Gasca and Ainara Badiola.

The generic name refers to the place of its discovery combined with the Greek term suchus, which translates to crocodile.
